transactions.desc: The Diamondbacks released Gurriel on Friday, Francys Romero of BeisbolFR.com reports.
The Giants reinstated Bericoto (knee) from the injured list Friday.
The Giants recalled Davitt from Triple-A Sacramento on Friday.
The Blue Jays released Sosa from Triple-A Buffalo on Friday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.
The Angels recalled Teodosio from Triple-A Salt Lake on Friday.
The Dodgers promoted Sirota from Double-A Tulsa to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Friday, broadcaster Alex Freedman of the OKC Comets reports.
The Rangers promoted Otanez from Triple-A Round Rock on Friday, per Evan Grant of The Dallas Morning News.
Texas optioned Ahlstrom to Triple-A Round Rock on Friday, per Evan Grant of The Dallas Morning News.
The Dodgers optioned Knack to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Friday.
The Dodgers activated Diaz (neck) from the 15-day injured list Friday.
The Twins recalled Roden from Triple-A St. Paul on Friday, Aaron Gleeman of AaronGleeman.com reports.
The Blue Jays designated Lorenzen for assignment Friday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.
The Phillies optioned Backhus to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Friday.
The Cardinals recalled Prieto from Triple-A Memphis on Friday.
The Cubs optioned Murray to Triple-A Iowa on Friday, Meghan Montemurro of the Chicago Tribune reports.
The Cubs activated Swanson (oblique) from the 10-day injured list Friday, Meghan Montemurro of the Chicago Tribune reports.
The Nationals signed Cavalli to a four-year contract extension Friday that includes a club option for 2031.
The Brewers recalled Gordon from Triple-A Nashville on Friday.
The Brewers optioned Stallings to Triple-A Nashville on Friday.
The Reds recalled Aguiar from Triple-A Louisville on Friday.
The Reds claimed Cabrera off waivers from the Yankees on Friday.
The Athletics optioned Rock to Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday.
The Athletics recalled Barnett from Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday.
The Orioles optioned Heuer to Triple-A Norfolk on Friday.
The Orioles recalled Povich from Triple-A Norfolk on Friday.
The Tigers recalled Madden from Triple-A Toledo on Thursday.
The Mets recalled Weston from Triple-A Syracuse on Thursday.
The Mets optioned Curry to Triple-A Syracuse on Thursday.
The Phillies claimed Urquidy off waivers from the White Sox on Thursday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Astros optioned Loperfido to Triple-A Sugar Land on Thursday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
